variants.name: .357 Magnum
variants.info:
Load your Henry 45-70 with .357 Magnum, making it the Henry Big Boy.
Bring back nostalgia of an era you were not even born in.

Converts your Henry 45-70 into the Henry 30-30, firing .30-30 Winchester.
Holds an extra round of ammunition with more accuracy, but less performance in some areas. Faster action.

variants.name: .410 Bore
variants.info:
Converts your Henry 45-70 into the Henry 410, firing .410 bore.
Immense power in close range and good accuracy, but faulters strongly at range.

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: Plus P
variants.info:
Overpacked with powder, these rounds aim to make your bullets fly faster, penetrate surfaces better, and increase suppression.
Harder to control.
